name: Velké Popovice (Czechia)
description: Four horizontal stripes of white, red, white and green in the ratio 1:1:1:1.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 17 October 1997 (decision No. 41) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
